# BibGuru

> > BibGuru is a free citation generator supporting 8000+ citation styles including APA, MLA, Harvard, Chicago, AMA, and CSE for academic research and writing.

BibGuru provides an intuitive platform for students and educators to generate accurate citations and manage bibliographies across multiple academic citation formats. The site offers both free tools and premium features, with multilingual support and educational resources.

## Key Topics

- APA citation

## Citation Generators

- [Free APA Citation Generator & Format Guide](https://www.bibguru.com/c/apa-citation-generator): Free APA 7 citation generator for in-text citations and reference lists
- [Free MLA Citation Generator](https://www.bibguru.com/c/mla-citation-generator): Free MLA citation generator for Works Cited entries and in-text citations
- [Free Harvard Referencing Generator](https://www.bibguru.com/c/harvard-citation-generator): Free Harvard referencing generator for quick citations from books, journals, websites
- [Free Chicago Citation Generator](https://www.bibguru.com/c/chicago-citation-generator): Free Chicago Manual of Style citation generator for reference lists and citations
- [Free AMA Citation Generator](https://www.bibguru.com/c/ama-citation-generator): Free American Medical Association citation generator for medical reference lists
- [Free CSE Citation Generator](https://www.bibguru.com/c/cse-citation-generator): Free Council of Science Editors citation generator for scientific writing

## Core Platform

- [BibGuru - A New FREE APA, Harvard, & MLA Citation Generator](https://www.bibguru.com): BibGuru homepage: free citation generator for APA, MLA, Harvard, and 8000+ styles
- [Upgrade to BibGuru Plus](https://www.bibguru.com/bibguru-plus): BibGuru Plus premium subscription upgrade with enhanced features
